info.title: SnowSignals x402 gateway
info.description: Market-phase data (TrendVane) over the x402 pay-per-call protocol. Paid endpoints require an x402 payment (USDC on Base); metadata endpoints are free. The phase names the market state for a currency on a timeframe.

get.description: The deterministic phase from the last closed bar. Metered per row; requires an x402 payment. The 402 response quotes the exact price.
The phase forming in the current bar; refreshed about once per minute. Metered per row; requires an x402 payment.
Enabled currencies, timeframes, phase labels, and the live pricing model. Free, no payment.
Successor-phase transition probabilities and reward-vs-drawdown stats. Free, no payment.

currency.name: currency
currency.description: A single currency (e.g. BTC), a comma list, or 'all'.

tf.name: tf
tf.description: A single timeframe, a comma list, or 'all'. One of 15m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 1d, 1w.

PaymentRequired.description: x402 payment required (x402 v2). The accepted payment requirements — price (USDC on Base), pay-to address, and asset — are carried in the base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header; an x402 client decodes it, signs a USDC authorization for the quoted amount, and retries. The response body is empty.

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: Base64-encoded x402 v2 PaymentRequired document: x402Version, accepts[] (scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo), and discovery extensions.

BadRequest.description: Invalid currency or timeframe, or a request exceeding the enabled-basket cap.
